price_basis: price-return both sides (Polygon daily closes; dividends excluded on the position AND the benchmark alike — never mixed with a total-return series)

spread.sign_convention: BUY−AVOID = mean(BUY excess) − mean(AVOID excess). An AVOID leg falling against its benchmark carries NEGATIVE excess, so subtracting it makes the spread MORE positive: being right about a terminal decline pays in exactly as being right about an overshoot.
spread.caveat: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY until each row reaches its horizon date (§7: never tuned on). A leg's excess is price-return vs its assigned benchmark over the same window.
